διατρύγιος: διατρύγιος — yielding a vintage (διά + τρύγη ’vintage’; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. sg.

εὐπείθης: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. nom. sg.

θάμβευς: θάμβος — amazement; neut. gen. sg., Ionic -ευς (= Attic θάμβους), gen. with a verb of forgetting

κατένευσεν: κατανεύω — nod assent, promise by a nod; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable

κερῶντάς: κεράννυμι (κεράω) — mix (wine with water); pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl., accented before enclitic τε

μίμνομεν: μίμνω (= μένω) — wait, stay; pres. 1 pl., with the force of a perfect: ’we have been waiting’

μυχμῷ: μυχμός — moaning (a low cry); masc. dat. sg., of manner
νέκυς: νέκυς — corpse, the dead; masc. acc. pl.
νήεσσιν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσιν (= Attic ναυσί)
νήρικον: Νήρικος — Nericus, a town on a headland of the mainland; masc. acc. sg.
νοστήσαντά: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic σε
νόστησας: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. 2 sg.

οἴκων: οἶκος — house, home; masc. gen. pl., plural for the one house
οὖλέ: οὖλος / οὔλω — be sound, hale; ’be well’, a greeting (exact form unclear: imper. or adj. voc.)
πέμπον: πέμπω — send, convey; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπον)
παρνησῷ: Παρνησός — Parnassus, the mountain; masc. dat. sg. of place (= Attic Παρνασσῷ)

πολίεσσι: πόλις — city; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πόλεσι)
πολίων: πόλις — city; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεων)
προΐεις: προΐημι — send forth; impf. 2 sg. (σύ … προΐεις ’you sent me’)
προμολοῦσα: προβλώσκω — come forward, go forth; aor. 2 part. fem. nom. sg.
προπάροιθ: προπάροιθε(ν) — in front of, before (+ gen.); prep., elided (προπάροιθ’)

σικελή: Σικελός — Sicel, of the Sicels; fem. nom. sg. Σικελή, agreeing with ἀμφίπολος and γρηῦς
σταφυλαὶ: σταφυλή — bunch of grapes, grape; fem. nom. pl.
συκέας: συκέη — fig tree; fem. acc. pl., uncontracted (Attic συκῆ)
σφόν: σφός — their own (possessive of the 3rd pl., distinct from σφεῖς ’they’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πατέρα
ταμνομένους: τάμνω (= τέμνω) — cut; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’cutting (for themselves)’

τρισκαίδεκα: τρεισκαίδεκα — thirteen; numeral, indeclinable (τρεῖς + καὶ + δέκα)

φθιμένοισι: φθίνω — perish; aor. mid. part. masc. dat. pl. as noun: ’the dead’ (= φθιμένοις)
φονῆας: φονεύς — killer, murderer; masc. acc. pl., Ionic -ῆας (= Attic φονεῖς)

ἀλωὴν: ἀλωή — cultivated plot, tilled ground, orchard; fem. acc. sg.

ἀνήγαγον: ἀνάγω — lead up, lead back; aor. 3 pl., 2nd aor.

ἐνέπουσα: ἐνέπω — tell, tell of, proclaim; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἐνήρατο: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg. mid., with active sense

ἐποτρύνωσι: ἐποτρύνω — speed on, urge on; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a fear clause after μή
ἐσθλοὺς: ἐσθλός — good, brave; masc. acc. pl.
ἐσσόμεθ: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 pl., epic double σ, elided (ἐσσόμεθ’ = ἐσσόμεθα; Attic ἐσόμεθα)
ἐφεστάμεναι: ἐφίστημι — set upon; intrans. stand by; inf. in -άμεναι (= Attic ἐφεστάναι)

ἔμαρψεν: μάρπτω — seize, lay hold of; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἔμαρψεν)
ἔτισαν: τίνω — pay, pay for; aor. 3 pl. (ὕβριν ἔτισαν ’paid for their insolence’)

ἵζ: ἵζω — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἵζ’ = ἵζε)
ὀδυσεῦς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg., short form beside Ὀδυσῆος (single σ)
ὀνόμηνας: ὀνομαίνω — name, mention; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμηνας)
ὀρχάτου: ὄρχατος — orchard, row of trees; masc. gen. sg.

ὀϊομένοισι: ὀΐομαι — think, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. pl., agreeing with ἡμῖν
ὄγχνας: ὄγχνη — pear tree; fem. acc. pl.
ὄρχους: ὄρχος — row (of vines or trees); masc. acc. pl.
ὄσσα: Ὄσσα — Rumour, report personified as a messenger; fem. nom. sg. (common noun ὄσσα ’voice, report’)

__broaden__.εἷλον: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (εἷλον = ἔ-ελον): ’they caught’ · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I took’ (οἷος Νήρικον εἷλον ’such as I took Nericus’)
__broaden__.μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus) · also of θυμός, ’great-hearted’ (μεγαλήτορα θυμόν) · also of Laertes, masc. acc. sg. (Λαέρτην μεγαλήτορα)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’) · also bare adv. after ἠέ ’than’, with no verb: ’before, formerly’ (μείζονα … ἠὲ πάρος ’taller than before’)
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’) · also + gen., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (fighting over a person) · also + acc. of the occupation: ’about, at’ (περὶ δεῖπνον πένοντο ’busied themselves about the meal’)
__broaden__.τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’) · also the enclitic indefinite as a substantive object after εἴ: ’anything’ (εἴ τί μιν εἴποι ’whether she would say anything to him’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective, accented before enclitic μοι: ’some’ (σῆμά τί μοι ’some sign for me’)
__broaden__.φράσαι: φράζομαι — consider, think out, take thought; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’consider’ · also aor. imper. mid. with the eyes: ’observe, take note of’ (οὐλὴν … φράσαι ὀφθαλμοῖσι ’observe this scar with your eyes’)
__broaden__.ἀλλάων: ἄλλος — other; fem. gen. pl., epic ἀλλάων (= Attic ἄλλων): ’of other (women)’ · also fem. gen. pl. of cities: ’of other (cities)’ (ἐξ ἀλλάων πολίων)
__broaden__.ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’) · also as adverb, no case: ’upon (them), thereon’ (ἔνθα δ’ ἀνὰ σταφυλαὶ ἔασιν ’and there upon them are grapes of every kind’)
__broaden__.ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’) · also in ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., purpose after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἑλοίμην ’so that I might take’)
__broaden__.ἐϋκτίμενον: ἐΰκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον, epic ἐϋ- (= εὖ) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with πτολίεθρον: ’well-built (citadel)’
__broaden__.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’sweet’ (ἡδὺ ποτόν ’sweet drink’) · also predicate, neut. nom. sg.: ’pleasant’ (οὐκ ἂν … ἡδὺ γένοιτο ζωέμεν ’it would not be pleasant to live’)
__broaden__.ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’ · also aor. mid. inf. of respect after θῆκεν: ’to look upon’ (μείζονα … θῆκεν ἰδέσθαι ’made taller to look upon’)
